name: string-test-618b121b6c/string-v.bal
spec_references: Subset restrictions > Import declarations: 'Only following lang libraries with given methods/types are supported'; ballerina/lang.string lists length, indexOf, includes, substring, equalsIgnoreCaseAscii, toLowerAscii, toUpperAscii, trim, toBytes and fromBytes, but not startsWith or endsWith.

Subset restrictions > Other invocation restrictions: 'Method call syntax can be used for calling the following langlib functions:' lists string:indexOf, string:includes, string:substring and string:equalsIgnoreCaseAscii, but not string:startsWith or string:endsWith.
Subset restrictions > Import declarations: ballerina/lang.value lists cloneWithType, fromJsonWithType, toString and toBalString; toJsonString is not listed.
reason: The asserted prefix/suffix results require startsWith and endsWith, which are absent from both supported lang.string functions and method-call lists. The asserted JSON serialization also requires unlisted toJsonString. These essential unsupported calls make the whole case a feature request.
test_design_notes: io:println is output instrumentation. The case also asserts Unicode code-point indexing/substrings, ASCII casing, trimming, value string conversion and byte-array contents; the unsupported calls alone determine classification.
